options.name: bbCloudRemoteRemoteKey
options.label: BELABOX Cloud Remote Key
options.description: Get it from your Secret URL at https://cloud.belabox.net/

options.name: bbCloudRemoteSendMessageTo
options.label: Send Chat Messages to
options.description: Choose which platforms to send chat responses to. Comma-separated list of platforms. Options are twitch,youtube,trovo,kick

options.name: bbCloudRemoteWsClientIndex
options.label: Websocket Client Index
options.description: The zero-indexed position of the BELABOX Cloud Remote WebSocket Client in Servers/Clients > Custom WebSocket Client

options.name: bbCloudRemoteManualSrtla
options.label: Manual SRTLA Enabled
options.description: Shows whether a manual SRTLA Relay is being used or not

options.name: bbCloudRemoteManualSrtlaPort
options.label: Manual SRTLA Port Number
options.description: A number with optional min, max, and increments
